claim: The required explicit artifact chmod is incompatible with blanket metadata denial; Landlock filesystem rules and generic seccomp allowances alone do not prove artifact-only metadata confinement.

caller.head: 1ac58a84b725bd6f17eec66727edc877c49c7e66
caller.positive_operation: runtime.chmod(493), setting mode 0755 after the two fresh copies

landlock.limitation: Filesystem rules do not restrict the listed metadata operations, including chmod.

seccomp.limitation: Classic filters do not dereference pathname pointers; continuing a notified original syscall does not establish race-free target identity.

lineage.head: 0f2a86fa9ef0daf760b77c662a5b762e17848598
lineage.role: capture, guardian and retention ownership components

next_obligation: Select and independently review genuine artifact target/effect/errno/alias-race/death/pending-request/seal semantics, or a proved filesystem view covering every accessible alias.
